name: arthabank
description: ArthaBank - digital banking and card payment platform built with MongoDB, NestJS, React and TypeScript

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node backend/scripts/setup-dev.mjs
scripts.dev:api: wait-on -t 900000 tcp:127.0.0.1:27018 && npm --prefix backend run start:dev
scripts.dev:switch: wait-on -t 900000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/health && npm --prefix backend run start:switch:dev
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
